_description: Position-loss weight per SMPL-X joint, read by get_mesh_from_smplx.py and get_skinned_mesh_from_smplx.py (--weights FILE for another file). 'default' applies to every joint, 'groups' override it, 'joints' (SMPL-X names or indices 0-75) override groups. Groups: wrists, fingers, left_fingers, right_fingers. Fingers include the fingertips.
